final_message:
`Q-REPORT.md` is written — three headings in order, all eight row labels exact, no commits made.

**Quarter at a glance:** €1,233,225 revenue, €467,940 costs, €765,285 net, 62.1% margin, 153 net adds, 95.5% close rate, +4.6% June, **-9.6% July**.

Two things worth your attention:

**A data discrepancy in the June monthly.** June's stated total costs (€158,240) don't match the sum of its own cost lines (€158,540) — a €300 gap. May and July both reconcile exactly, so June is the outlier. I used the line-item sum on the assumption the total is a transcription slip, and flagged it in Notes for correction at source. The choice is immaterial to the report: quarterly margin rounds to 62.1% either way.

**The quarterly totals flatter a declining trend.** The 62.1% margin is an average of 63.4% / 63.2% / 59.4%, and the 153 net adds are 69 / 52 / 32 — halving each month, with signings falling *and* churn nearly doubling (17 → 31) simultaneously. I wrote the Summary to lead with the trajectory rather than the aggregate, since a leadership reader who sees only the totals would take away the wrong picture. Notes also flags that marketing was cut 20.7% in the same month revenue fell 9.6% — the monthlies don't establish causality, but it's the obvious question before the next budget is set.
